sources.note: Original Matic/Polygon PoS staking contract set. Repository archived by upstream ~2024-03; no upstream security response stream.
Maintained successor of the same 0.5.x codebase; same StakeManager / ValidatorShare / StakingInfo units. Still GPL-3.0-only.

components.unit: StakeManager.stakeFor / restake / unstake / unstakeClaim; WITHDRAWAL_DELAY = 2**13 epochs
components.purpose: Validator bonding and a fixed-delay unbond claim.
components.target_obligation: The D5 collateral-reservation lifecycle: reserve on election, protect after acknowledged retirement, release only past every gate.
components.removed_upstream_test: StakeManager unstake / unstakeClaim dynasty and WITHDRAWAL_DELAY test cases.
components.local_home: P2 (immutable native stake custody), contract repo chosen in P2; gate model already in evmroot/d5retire.go and testdata/d5-vectors.json.
components.replacement: evmroot/d5retire.go Reservation + ProtectionParams. Delay is Delta_hold in certified root rounds with Delta_hold > Delta_ev + Delta_incl + Delta_exec, plus the forced-inbox position cutoff and the pending-evidence gate; not a single fixed epoch count, and requesting retirement does not start the clock.
components.note: Reference the state-machine shape only: request -> deactivation epoch -> claim after a delay. Re-implemented against root rounds, not Heimdall epochs.

components.unit: StakeManager.checkSignatures / _increaseRewardAndAssertConsensus / rewardPerStake / CHECKPOINT_REWARD / _updateRewardsAndCommit; proposer bonus and combinedStakePower split
components.purpose: Checkpoint-submission-driven reward accrual and consensus assertion.
components.target_obligation: Assigned-weight reward per certified root interval.
components.replacement: Replaced by the governance.tex closed-interval reward formula; see accounting replacement "assigned-weight-reward".
components.note: Checkpoint coupling: the whole accrual is driven by RootChain checkpoint submission and a per-checkpoint decreasing pool. The new reward is a function of certified root-round progress and effective weight only.

components.purpose: Apply a slashing batch validated by Heimdall consensus signatures over a checkpoint.
components.target_obligation: Objective double-sign slashing over the D5 vote domain, submitted by anyone.
components.replacement: Replaced by D5 vote-domain + S1/S2; see accounting replacement "objective-slashing-penalty".
components.note: The Heimdall/checkpoint signature path is removed entirely. Anyone may submit authenticated conflicting votes; the forced inbox preserves a timely commitment while execution is delayed.

components.unit: SlashingManager penalty arithmetic: amount cap, reporter bounty, remainder routing, and the per-offence de-duplication guard
components.purpose: Penalty arithmetic and the anti-double-charge guard.
components.target_obligation: S2 objective-slashing arithmetic against D5 collateral attribution.
components.removed_upstream_test: SlashingManager slash-list and checkpoint-signature verification tests.
components.local_home: S2 (objective slashing and liability holds), contract repo chosen in P2.
components.replacement: Re-implemented in S2: charge attributable active/retiring collateral once, bounded submitter bounty, remainder to treasury, duplicate-offence guard keyed by the D5 conflict identity, checks-effects-interactions on the bounty credit.
components.note: Reference the arithmetic shape (cap / bounty / remainder / dedupe). The trigger and the collateral model are new.

components.unit: ValidatorShare: exchangeRate / withdrawExchangeRate / buyVoucher / sellVoucher(_new) / commissionRate / _calculateReward / _calculateRewardPerShareWithRewards / EXCHANGE_RATE_PRECISION / getLiquidRewards
components.purpose: Delegation share issuance, commission, and per-delegator reward math.
components.target_obligation: None in the initial profile: self-bond only; delegation calls are rejected (roadmap P2).
components.deferred_to: A future delegation upgrade. governance.tex "Stake Registry" allows the first PoS deployment to disable delegation and use self-bond only; roadmap P2 says do not expose a partially implemented share API. That upgrade carries its own historical share / commission-loss tests through rotations and exits.
components.note: Kept as an algorithm reference (exchange-rate accumulator; commission split reward.sub(validatorReward).mul(commissionRate).div(MAX_COMMISION_RATE)). Not on the initial audit surface; no voucher code is written for M4S.

components.unit: StakingNFT (ERC-721 validator ownership) + validatorAuction (startAuction / confirmAuctionBid / dethroneAndStake)
components.purpose: Transferable validator slots and slot auctions.
components.target_obligation: None: identity is a stable, non-transferable staking account (D5 / P3).
components.replacement: Replaced by P3 identity binding; see accounting replacement "validator-identity-bookkeeping".
components.note: No transfer, no auction, no dethrone refund. Removes the NFT-transfer reward/stake carry, the auction escrow and the dethrone path from the surface.

components.unit: StakingInfo: getStakerDetails / getAccountStateRoot / verifyConsensus / updateNonce (checkpoint Merkle account-root helpers + event logger)
components.purpose: Off-chain indexing events and checkpoint account-state-root verification for slashing/rewards.
components.target_obligation: A minimal local event set; no checkpoint account-state-root.
components.replacement: The account-state-root / verifyConsensus helpers are dropped: the root consumes the certified contract output and does not re-run the staking algorithm (governance.tex "Trust Base Derivation" step 1). P5 emits the deterministic snapshot identity and candidate fields; P2 emits a minimal bonded / reserved / slashed event set.
components.note: Event logging is re-created minimally where P2 / P5 need it; the Merkle-proof plumbing is not.

components.unit: Registry / Governable / GovernanceLockable / UpgradableProxy (mutable address book + upgradeable proxies over the staking system)
components.purpose: A central mutable registry of contract addresses and upgradeable proxies for custody logic.
components.target_obligation: Immutable custody with policy / custody separation.
components.note: No value accounting of its own: it is address indirection plus a proxy admin that can replace custody logic. governance.tex "Upgrade and Delivery Boundaries" makes money custody, withdrawal accounting, allocation, wrapper and vault contracts immutable in the initial profile; stake custody and its fixed slash/exit rules are separated from election policy, and policy changes have bounded permissions and timelocks (roadmap P7). No upgradeable proxy sits over custody.

components.unit: StateSender / IStateReceiver (state-sync to Bor) + topUpForFee / claimFee (Heimdall fee token)
components.purpose: Cross-chain state sync to the child chain and a separate Heimdall fee-token balance.
components.replacement: Bridge state-sync is not needed in Setup 2 (each operator runs a paired reth node; the root feeds certified progress through the mandatory state feed). Fee handling is replaced per accounting replacement "fee-accounting".
components.note: Removes the StateSender coupling and the second fee token. This is the "bridge coupling" the ticket calls out; the accounting duty it carried (the Heimdall fee escrow) is re-homed to T3.

components.unit: openzeppelin-solidity 0.5.x: SafeMath / ERC20 / Ownable / ReentrancyGuard / Math
components.purpose: Checked arithmetic, access control and reentrancy guards at solc 0.5.
components.target_obligation: Current audited primitives at the P2 toolchain.
components.note: SafeMath 0.5 is obsolete under solc >= 0.8 built-in checked arithmetic. Replaced by solc >= 0.8 semantics plus a current audited library (e.g. OpenZeppelin 5.x or Solady) pinned in P2, with explicit unchecked blocks only where proven safe. This is a library swap, not an accounting change.

accounting_replacements.duty: Bind bonded collateral to an assignment, keep it reserved across epoch extension / pending candidate / cancelled transition, and release it only after an authenticated statement that the stake backs no active or prepared successor.
accounting_replacements.replacement: D4 epoch-handoff state machine + D5 reservation lifecycle. Election fixes effective weight and reserves the matching collateral (governance.tex "Election"). AcknowledgeRetirement records R_ret only when backsActiveOrPrepared is false; phases Bonded -> RetirementRequested -> Draining -> Released. Withdrawal needs now >= max(R_ret + Delta_hold, inheritedProtectionUntil), the forced-inbox position cutoff through LiabilityDeadlineRound, and no pending timely evidence. Cancellation/replacement of a prepared handoff needs a root-certified abort plus an EVM acknowledgement that releases the reservations. Root consumes the certified contract output; validators do not re-run the staking algorithm.
accounting_replacements.spec_ref: governance.tex "Stake Registry", "Election", "Trust Base Derivation" (steps 1-5), "Economic Invariants" (1-4); docs/adr/0006 (D4); docs/adr/0007 (D5); evmroot/d5retire.go.

accounting_replacements.duty: Size a per-interval reward pool, apply a proposer bonus, and split it by validator vs delegator stake power on every checkpoint (StakeManager rewardPerStake / CHECKPOINT_REWARD / _increaseRewardAndAssertConsensus).
accounting_replacements.replacement: governance.tex "Rewards": for a closed interval I wholly within one acknowledged assignment e, R_nu(I) = E(I) * b_nu / W_e with E(I) = min(rho_e * |I|, Pool_free); |I| counts certified root-round progress; no proposer bonus. Boundaries split I on assignment or rate change; a skipped root round is one interval and a retry never accrues it twice; idle assigned validators are still paid (explicit initial-policy limitation). Integer arithmetic, rounding remainder stays in its source pot; settlement is idempotent, bounded, permissionless, cannot process an unacknowledged future interval; claims use checks-effects-interactions; one failing claim never blocks another. Downtime / QC-omission is not an input.
accounting_replacements.spec_ref: governance.tex "Rewards", "Fees"; roadmap T8 (optional assignment rewards); roadmap P7 (economic integration).

accounting_replacements.duty: Apply a slashing batch: debit the offender's validator + delegation stake, credit a reporter/proposer, update totals, and jail (StakeManager.slash / SlashingManager.updateSlashedAmounts, gated by Heimdall checkpoint signatures).
accounting_replacements.replacement: D5 SlashableConflict over (accountableKey, network, messageDomain, votingEpoch, votingRound) with the signed VoteInfo/LedgerCommitInfo binding; S1 consensus-signature primitive; S2 objective slashing. Accepted evidence charges the attributable active or retiring collateral once, credits a bounded submitter bounty, and transfers the remainder to treasury; a duplicate offence costs no extra principal; jailing excludes the validator from future elections while its consensus weight changes only at a committed handoff. Slashing transfers collateral and never creates or destroys native UCT.
accounting_replacements.spec_ref: governance.tex "Slashing", "Slashed Stake" rule; appendix-evm.tex "Evidence"; docs/adr/0007 (D5); roadmap S1-S2; evmroot/d5vote.go.

accounting_replacements.duty: Keep reward/stake bookkeeping attached to a validator across signer changes and unbonding (StakeManager.updateSigner, ValidatorShare unbond nonces).
accounting_replacements.replacement: D5 InheritedProtectionUntil carries the maximum applicable protection across key rotation and delegation changes; historical bindings survive rotation and exit for accountability; slashing applies to that collateral and its attributable unbonding shares, not merely the current free balance. Key rotation, delegation changes and queued withdrawals cannot remove liability for an earlier attributable offence. P3 registers stable staking identity with proof of possession and unique active bindings; rotation activates only through the committed assignment.
accounting_replacements.spec_ref: governance.tex "Stake Registry", "Economic Invariants" (4); docs/adr/0007 (D5); roadmap P3-P4.

accounting_replacements.duty: Escrow a separate Heimdall fee-token balance per validator and let it be claimed (StakeManager.topUpForFee / claimFee).
accounting_replacements.replacement: No separate staking fee token. T3 FeeCollector receives priority fees through protocol balance accounting without calling its contract code; permissionless settlement splits attributable receipts between the reward pot and an independent Treasury; unexpected transfers are accounted separately; base-fee destruction is in the EVM native-currency supply accounting.

accounting_replacements.duty: Move stake/reward bookkeeping when validator ownership transfers, and run slot auctions / dethrone refunds (StakingNFT ERC-721, validatorAuction startAuction/confirmAuctionBid/dethroneAndStake).
accounting_replacements.replacement: P3 identity, possession and historical key binding: a stable, non-transferable staking account with an owner key and distinct consensus / node roles, proof of possession, and unique active bindings. No transferable validator NFT and no slot auction in the initial profile; set membership changes only through the certified election and committed handoff.

decision.choice: Clean-room minimal self-bond. No Polygon source is vendored or ported into the contract set. A short, named list of algorithm shapes is used as reference only; every line of staking-contract code for M4S is written locally under Apache-2.0 in the repository chosen by P2.
decision.rationale: Three independent reasons point the same way. (1) Licence: every pinned Polygon staking revision is GPL-3.0-only; bft-core is Apache-2.0 and its custody contracts are immutable, so a copyleft port cannot land in that set. (2) Toolchain: the code is solc 0.5.17 with openzeppelin-solidity 0.5.x; moving it to a modern compiler is a rewrite, not a port, and a rewrite carries no upstream review. (3) Surface: auctions, the validator NFT, delegation vouchers, Heimdall fee tokens and checkpoint state-sync are all unused in the initial self-bond profile, so a port would import dead, audit-bearing code. The reused behaviours (delayed unbond, a reward-per-weight accumulator, a cap/bounty/remainder penalty split, the checks-effects-interactions claim pattern) are small, well understood, and cheaper to re-implement against the D4/D5 lifecycle than to retrofit.
decision.licence_constraint: maticnetwork/contracts and 0xPolygon/pos-contracts are both GPL-3.0-only. GPL-3.0 -> Apache-2.0 relicensing is not permitted, so no upstream source is copied into the Apache-2.0 contract set. A separately-housed GPL-3.0 staking package built by porting is theoretically possible but is an owner / governance decision about a new distributable artifact and is out of P1 scope; this assessment does not choose it.
decision.security_audit_owner: roadmap X-series — X2 (pre-TGE audit and remediation) and X4 / X5 (PoS shadow audit and integrated activation gate). Not upstream Polygon review, and not a green local test run.
